title: Renew the registration on a vehicle with outstanding defects
summary: Learn how to renew your vehicle registration if your vehicle has outstanding defects by passing a specialist inspection and safety check.
intro:
If your vehicle has been issued with a defect notice, you can renew your registration after the vehicle passes a specialist inspection, has all defects cleared, and passes another safety check.

Once you've passed the safety check, please visit a Service NSW Centre.
who_can_apply: Your vehicle has been issued with a defect notice.
what_you_need: Your renewal notice (unless you have opted in to Digital Vehicle Registration)
A safety inspection report (pink slip) dated after the defect notices (the mechanic will notify Transport for NSW (TfNSW) electronically)
Compulsory third party (CTP) insurance policy (green slip) (your insurer will usually send this electronically to TfNSW)
Details of vehicle design alterations (if applicable)

how_to_steps.text: Make sure you have all the required documentation.
Visit a service centre and provide your information in person.
